python3 -c "
import yaml, json, re, sys
content = open('journals/2026-08-18-shop-handover-chaos-and-products-3.md').read()
m = re.match(r'^---\n(.*?)\n---\n', content, re.S)
fm = yaml.safe_load(m.group(1))
print(json.dumps(fm, indent=2)[:200])
try:
    import jsonschema
    schema = json.load(open('.claude/skills/investigate/journal.schema.json'))
    jsonschema.validate(fm, schema)
    print('SCHEMA OK')
except ImportError:
    print('jsonschema not installed, skipping strict validation')
except Exception as e:
    print('SCHEMA ERROR:', e)
"
